issue_context.title: -K option no longer works for become_password
issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY

After 2165f9ac40cf212891b11a75bd9b9b2f4f0b8dc3, `-K` no longer works for become password.

#69629 has a fix to send it to the plugin and get things working again, but @bcoca suggested we should try to do something other than threading it through TQM -> play_context.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
become, task_executor

##### ANSIBLE VERSION

devel after 2165f9ac40cf212891b11a75bd9b9b2f4f0b8dc3

review_comments: this will not pickup `ansible_<plugin>_pass` variable overrides for connections, what we need to do is pass the become(become_pass)/connection(password) pass to the 'set_options' of both plugins in the task_keys option (merging with existing task_keys dict) so this fixes become plugins, but we still need to add the same for connections. Also connections themselves need to start using get_options .. but that is bigger fix
eventually we should just handle the passwords directly in task_worker vs sideloading via play_context, but that is a bigger change
